reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Class Puppet Boxes 007
materials.text: After the puppet show, we tidy up. The fox goes in the tall box. The little bird goes in the small box. The king’s crown is not a toy to wear home. Put it on the shelf. Count the two sticks before closing the tall box. Leave the curtain open to dry.

questions.prompt: Your friend puts the fox in the small box. You say, "____"
options: Use the tall box for the fox.
The fox goes on the roof.
Put the bird in the bin.
questions.explanation: A狐狸用高盒；B屋顶非收纳处；C鸟用小盒不丢弃。

questions.prompt: Your friend asks where to put the little bird. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B鸟入小盒；A湿帘下、C王冠内未安排。

questions.prompt: Your friend wears the crown to go home. You say, "____"
options: Please leave it on the shelf.
questions.explanation: C皇冠不能戴回家，应放架；A与禁带走相反；B剪成棒非要求。

questions.prompt: Your friend closes the tall box too soon. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A关高盒前数两根棒；B开校门、C弄湿盒无关。

questions.prompt: Your friend closes the wet curtain. You say, "____"
options: Put it in the bird box.
questions.explanation: B帘敞开晾干；A收湿帘入鸟盒、C放雨里与晾干不合。

materials.title: Kite Field Lines 007
materials.text: Fly kites on the grass. Keep away from the road and the big tree. The short string is for the small kite. Ask an adult to untie a knot. Stop flying when the rain starts. Put wet kites on the covered bench, not in bags.

questions.prompt: A friend walks towards the road with a kite. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A草地放且远离道路；B道路、C大树都应远离。

questions.prompt: A friend gives the small kite a very long string. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B小风筝用短线；A无绳、C袋代绳均非安排。

questions.prompt: A friend finds a knot in the string. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C结找成人解；A拉断、B藏鞋下不解决指定问题。

questions.prompt: Rain starts while a friend is flying. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A下雨停飞；B继续高飞相反；C靠路也违限制。

questions.prompt: A friend puts a wet kite into a bag. You say, "____"
options: Put it on the covered bench.
questions.explanation: B湿风筝置有遮挡长椅；A树、C水坑均不是指定位置。

materials.title: Bread Roll Packing 007
materials.text: We pack bread rolls for the school sale. Use paper bags, not plastic bags. Put two rolls in each bag. Do not touch the rolls with dirty hands. Mia’s bag has no seeds; it stays on the blue tray. Put full bags on the front table.

questions.prompt: A friend reaches for a plastic bag. You say, "____"
options: Put the rolls in your pocket.
questions.explanation: A用纸袋非塑料；B两塑料袋仍违规则；C衣袋非食品包装。

questions.prompt: A friend puts one roll into a bag and stops. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B每袋两只，已有一只再加一；A变零、C变六均不符。

questions.prompt: A friend has dirty hands and touches the bread. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C脏手不能碰食物，应先清洁；A扩大接触、B隐藏不解决问题。

questions.prompt: A friend moves Mia’s bag to the front table. You say, "____"
options: Leave it on the blue tray.
questions.explanation: A无籽专袋留蓝盘；B添加种子与no seeds冲突；C无丢弃要求。

questions.prompt: A friend finishes a normal bag of two rolls. You say, "____"
options: Put it under a wet towel.
Put it on the front table.
questions.explanation: B普通装满袋置前桌；A湿毛巾下、C垃圾桶均非安排。

materials.title: Fire Station Visit 007
materials.text: Our class visits a fire station. We see a long red truck. A firefighter shows us a heavy coat. I try it on with her help. It is too big for me. We can sit in the truck, but we cannot press any buttons. Before we leave, the firefighter gives us a card with a fire truck on it. I put my card in my reading book.

questions.prompt: The class visits a police station.
questions.explanation: B正确：fire station是消防站；A换成警察局。

questions.prompt: The firefighter’s coat is heavy.
questions.explanation: A正确：heavy coat明确；B否认重量描述。

questions.prompt: The coat fits the writer well.
questions.explanation: B正确：too big for me表示太大；A说正合身相反。

questions.prompt: The children may sit in the truck.
questions.explanation: A正确：can sit明确允许；B把许可说成禁止。

questions.prompt: The writer puts the card in a reading book.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句卡片放阅读书里；B否认去处。

materials.title: Plant Name Stones 007
materials.text: We paint names on flat stones for our plants. I write "mint" on my stone. My sister writes "bean" on hers. We wait until the paint is dry. Then we put the stones in front of the right pots. It rains that night. The paper labels get wet, but our stone names are still clear. Grandma asks us to make a stone for her rose plant too.

questions.prompt: The children write plant names on flat stones.
questions.explanation: A正确：paint names on flat stones；B否认所用标记。

questions.prompt: The writer’s sister writes "mint".
questions.explanation: B正确：姐姐写bean，作者写mint；A交换人物。

questions.prompt: They put the stones in place before the paint dries.
questions.explanation: B正确：等paint dry再摆；A把顺序颠倒。

questions.prompt: The stone names are clear after the rain.
questions.explanation: A正确：still clear明确；B混淆湿纸签与石头字。

questions.prompt: Grandma wants a stone for a rose plant.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句rose plant；B与请求相反。

materials.title: Lunch Line Tokens 007
materials.text: The school tries a new lunch system. Each class gets a time card. Our class card says 12:15. We do not queue before that time. At the dining hall door, each pupil takes a round token. After receiving a meal, we put it in a bowl near the kitchen window. The tokens help cooks count how many meals have been served. We still tell the kitchen about food we cannot eat in the morning. A token does not show that information.

questions.prompt: The class should queue before 12:15.
questions.explanation: B正确：not before卡上12:15；A漏读否定。

questions.prompt: Pupils take a round token at the dining hall door.
questions.explanation: A正确：门口领取圆牌；B否认领取点。

questions.prompt: Pupils keep the tokens after receiving meals.
questions.explanation: B正确：取餐后放窗口附近碗中；A说保留与归还冲突。

questions.prompt: Cooks use the tokens to count served meals.
questions.explanation: A正确：count meals served明确用途；B否认计数作用。

questions.prompt: The tokens tell cooks which foods each pupil cannot eat.
questions.explanation: B正确：牌不含此信息，早上另告知；A混淆计餐与饮食限制。

materials.title: Holiday Key Envelope 007
materials.text: Mr Tan goes away for three days. He asks his neighbour Jo to water the plants. He leaves his house key in a yellow envelope. Jo collects it from him on Friday evening, not from under a flowerpot. A note inside says, "Water the kitchen plants on Saturday. The garden plants have enough water." Jo puts a tick on the note after she finishes. On Sunday, she checks the kitchen soil but adds no water because it is still wet. When Mr Tan returns on Monday, Jo hands the key back to him.

questions.prompt: How does Jo get the house key?
questions.explanation: A周五亲自交接；B明确not under flowerpot；C植物里非地点。

questions.prompt: What colour is the key envelope?
questions.explanation: B yellow envelope；A白、C绿均不符。

questions.prompt: Which plants need water on Saturday?
questions.explanation: C便条指定厨房植物；A花园水足；B忽略厨房需浇。

questions.prompt: Why does Jo add no water on Sunday?
options: The kitchen soil is still wet.
questions.explanation: A检查仍湿；B钥匙未丢；C已请周六浇。

questions.prompt: What does Jo do when Mr Tan returns?
options: Hide the key in the garden.
Give the key to a stranger.
questions.explanation: B周一当面归还；A藏园、C交陌生人均未发生。

materials.title: Book Cover Repair Day 007
materials.text: Our class helps the library on Thursday. We sort old books into two piles. Books with loose paper covers go to our table. Books with torn pages go to the librarian. We do not tape pages ourselves. A helper shows us how to make a new paper cover. We write the title on the front and leave the back plain. Before returning each book to the shelf, we check that it can open easily. A cover that is too tight must be made again.

questions.prompt: The class helps the library on Thursday.
questions.explanation: A正确：on Thursday直接给日期；B否认时间。

questions.prompt: All damaged books go to the pupils’ table.
questions.explanation: B正确：破页书交管理员，仅松封面到学生桌；A把分流扩大成全部。

questions.prompt: The pupils tape torn pages themselves.
questions.explanation: B正确：do not tape pages；A漏读否定。

questions.prompt: The title is written on the front of the new cover.
questions.explanation: A正确：write title on front；B与要求相反。

questions.prompt: A book must open easily before it goes back on the shelf.
questions.explanation: A正确：上架前检查能轻松打开；B否认验收条件。

materials.title: Museum Sketch Stools 007
materials.text:
Choose from the bank to complete the passage. Use each word once. Bank: A. across B. borrow C. empty D. return E. carefully
At the gallery, pupils can ____1____ a folding stool from the front desk. They must carry it ____2____ because the legs can swing open. Our group walks ____3____ the hall to the animal paintings. We sit and draw for twenty minutes. When we finish, we ____4____ the stools to the same desk. The helper checks that each seat is ____5____ before folding it; no sketchbook should be left on top.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: B borrow借用折凳合义；A across介词、C empty形容词、E carefully副词不作所需动词；D return是结束时归还，非起始领取。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: E carefully修饰carry并对应凳腿会摆开；A across后缺宾语且无小心义；B borrow、D return动词、C empty形容词均不作所需方式副词。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: A across the hall表示穿过大厅；B borrow、D return不能接在walks后如此构句；C empty形容词、E carefully副词后不能直接接the hall表穿越。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: D return归还至原台；B borrow与结束后返台语境相反；A across介词、C empty形容词、E carefully副词不作本句谓语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: C empty对应座上不能留本子；A across介词缺宾语；B borrow、D return动词、E carefully副词不能作描述seat状态的表语。

materials.title: Club Bus Delay Message 007
materials.text: The nature club planned to return from the lake at four. At half past three, the coach driver found a problem with a tyre. The teacher sent a message to families before arranging a replacement coach. Her first message said the group was safe but the return time was uncertain. Some parents asked for an exact time. She explained that she would give one when transport was confirmed. At four ten, a second coach arrived. The teacher then sent a new arrival time of five fifteen. Two pupils had no phone contact listed, so the school office called their emergency contacts. The group stayed together at the visitor centre until the replacement was ready.

questions.prompt: The first message gave an exact new arrival time.
questions.explanation: B正确：最初返回时间uncertain；A把后续确认时间提前。

questions.prompt: The teacher told families the group was safe.
questions.explanation: A正确：first message group safe；B否认通知内容。

questions.prompt: A replacement coach arrived at 4:10.
questions.explanation: A正确：At four ten second coach arrived；B与时间事实相反。

questions.prompt: The school ignored pupils without listed phone contacts.
questions.explanation: B正确：办公室联系紧急联系人；A将另渠道联系说成忽视。

questions.prompt: The pupils remained together while waiting.
questions.explanation: A正确：stayed together visitor centre；B否认等候安排。

units.title: 社区故事录音的剪辑选择

materials.title: Oral History Consent 007
materials.text:
For a local-history project, pupils recorded residents talking about the old market. Before recording, they explained where the clips might be played. One resident, Mrs Yu, agreed to speak but asked them not to use a story about her neighbour. The pupils marked that section in their notes.
During editing, they found that the neighbour’s story was lively and funny. A pupil argued that it would make the exhibition more popular. The group leader replied that a good story did not cancel the condition under which it had been shared. They removed it and checked that no short pieces of it remained in the introduction.
The final display included a brief note saying that some sections had been left out with the speaker’s agreement. It did not name the neighbour or explain the private story. Mrs Yu listened to the edited clip before it opened to visitors. She corrected the date of one market event, and the pupils added that correction to their written transcript as well.

questions.prompt: What did Mrs Yu ask the pupils to leave out?
questions.explanation: B明确邻居故事不使用；A仍谈市场；C只后来改一日期；D保留文字稿。

questions.prompt: Why did one pupil want to keep that section?
questions.explanation: C活泼有趣可能吸引观众；A不是唯一；B与隐私条件不符；D无教师要求。

questions.prompt: What principle guided the final editing?
options: Respect the condition agreed before recording.
Use any story that attracts visitors.
Hide every correction from the speaker.
questions.explanation: A组长强调分享条件仍有效；B和D以热度推翻条件错误；C让说者听并修正。

questions.prompt: What did the display note avoid doing?
questions.explanation: D不披露邻居及故事；A和C说明有删节；B仍展历史。

questions.prompt: Where was the date correction added?
options: Only to a private phone message.
To the written transcript as well.
Nowhere, because the audio was finished.
questions.explanation: B同步加文字稿；A非仅私讯；C没另创邻居故事；D确已更正。

materials.title: Solar Lamp Comparison 007
materials.text:
The science club compared two solar lamps for the school path. Lamp A was cheaper, while Lamp B had a larger panel. Pupils placed both in sunlight for the same number of hours. That evening, Lamp B stayed bright for longer. They planned to recommend it immediately.
A caretaker asked where the lamps would actually be used. Half the path lay under tall trees, and the club had tested only an open part. The pupils repeated the test under the trees. Both lamps gave less light there, and neither lasted until the end of the evening club session. Instead of simply choosing the brighter lamp from the first test, the report described which parts of the path needed another solution. It also kept the price comparison, because a more expensive lamp was not automatically useful in every position.

questions.prompt: Lamp B had a larger solar panel than Lamp A.
questions.explanation: A正确：B较大面板；B否认已知配置差异。

questions.prompt: The first test took place under tall trees.
questions.explanation: B正确：首测open part阳光处；A把复测场景当首测。

questions.prompt: Both lamps performed worse in the shaded part.
questions.explanation: A正确：树下both less light，均未撑到结束；B否认复测结果。

questions.prompt: The club’s final report recommended Lamp B for every part of the path.
questions.explanation: B正确：部分路径需其他办法；A将首测初意当最终普遍建议。

questions.prompt: The report still included the price comparison.
questions.explanation: A正确：also kept price comparison；B与保留事实相反。
